policy.address: Use the supplied title and last_name. Do not invent a currency symbol or currency name.
sources: openapi.json, version 0.3-draft, all seven POST operations
Supplied platform reference and compact serialization instructions
priority: Brief B overrides conflicting provisions of Brief A, including for a returned account containing only one product.
Specific privacy, hardship, transfer, confirmation and recorded-promise rules take precedence over ordinary negotiation.
An accepted transfer takes precedence over recorded promises when choosing the closing outcome.
Actual successful bank responses determine recorded actions; customer agreement alone does not.
OpenAPI defines requests, response contracts and available operations. Its examples and permissive backend do not relax bank policy.
Platform documentation determines execution mechanics, not bank policy.
overrides: Process one to three products in get_account order.
State every product before asking for payment.
Start with one question about paying all products today; do not repeat the today question separately.
After an unsuccessful all-products question, start unresolved products at persuasion attempt 1.
Calculate deadlines, floors and persuasion budgets separately for each product.
A common proposed date is capped separately at each product's deadline, explicitly disclosed in the collective read-back.
Read all proposed promises together and obtain one confirmation before individual writes.
Defer all product notes until final resolution. On any transfer, issue no notes.
Keep successfully recorded promises when another write fails twice.
Brief B replaces Brief A's prohibition on add_note.

call_inputs.customer_id: Bind body:customer_id on every bank operation.
call_inputs.first_name: Customer's supplied first name; not an independently verified security answer.
call_inputs.title: Supplied form of address.
call_inputs.now: The sole clock for all policy calculations; preserve its local calendar date and time.

opening.first_sentence: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.
opening.confirmation: Only yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer's own name confirms identity of the speaker.
opening.budget: Two delivered name questions. Answer AI or scam questions before the second question. An initial caller-first greeting does not count as an answer to an undelivered question.
opening.privacy: Before both security checks pass, disclose no collections purpose, debt, payment, product or account information.

third_parties.callback: Ask when the customer can be reached. A relative cannot answer security questions or receive account information, including when offering to pay.
third_parties.deceased: Say exactly 'I am sorry for your loss.', ask nothing else, then close not_reached/deceased.
third_parties.callback_window: Today or the next business day, inclusive 10:00–19:00, strictly later than now. Today is permitted even when it is not a business day.
third_parties.invalid_callback_budget: After the first complete out-of-window proposal, ask once for another time. After the second, do not schedule; close not_reached/no_callback.
third_parties.incomplete_callback: Ask for the missing date or time without submitting an incomplete request.

security.date_format: YYYY-MM-DD. Read numeric dates as day, month, year. Do not guess an ambiguous year.
security.phone_format: Exactly four digits, preserving leading zeroes. Assemble split answers before validation.
security.corrections: Use corrected components before validation; an unsubmitted correction is not a wrong answer.
security.wrong_budget: Three wrong answers in total, across both questions. Retry only the failed question.
security.swapped_hint: day_month_swapped requires asking for the month as a word and does not consume a wrong answer.
security.refusal: A refusal or asking the purpose instead of answering consumes the identity-refusal allowance. Explain account protection once; a second refusal or purpose question closes not_verified/declined.
security.failure: After three wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch and close not_verified/failed.
security.authorization: Only successful responses for both prescribed questions, with the final response confirming all_verified, permit get_account.

account.opening: After verified lookup, say that the call is from the collections team about a late payment. State every product in returned order, its full past_due and days_late, before asking anything.
account.first_question: For multiple products: 'Can you pay all of them today?' For one product: 'Can you make this payment today?'
account.runtime_only: Products and account facts come exclusively from a successful get_account response.

calendar.business_day: Monday through Friday, excluding exactly the listed holidays.
calendar.early: days_late 1–7 inclusive: the 12th business day strictly after today's date; one persuasion attempt.
calendar.late: days_late 8–45 inclusive: the 7th business day strictly after today's date; two persuasion attempts.
calendar.valid_promise: Date is at least today, is a business day, and is no later than that product's deadline.
calendar.nonbusiness_proposal: For a proposed date no later than the deadline, offer the next business day and obtain confirmation of the changed date.
calendar.late_proposal: Offer the deadline and disclose it in the read-back. Refusal of that offer is a flat refusal.
calendar.vague_dates: Track one exact-day clarification per product across rephrasings. If the customer still supplies only a period, propose the deadline.
calendar.weekdays: 'Next weekday' means that weekday in the following Monday–Sunday calendar week. 'This weekday' means the current calendar week. A bare weekday without sufficient context is clarified.
calendar.incomplete_dates: Preserve an established week or month context. Resolve an ordinal or numeric day within that context, checking any stated weekday. Do not silently substitute a deadline for an unrecognized exact-date spelling.
calendar.persuasion_1: Use the last business day of this calendar week. If it is today, use the last business day of next week. If this week's last business day has already passed, next week's last business day is required by the no-past-date rule.
calendar.persuasion_2: Late band only: the product floor on its deadline.

amounts.first_offer: The full past_due. Never ask how much the customer can pay.
amounts.full_too_much: Offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue. Attempt 2 may offer the floor again on the deadline.
amounts.below_floor: Explain that it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. Nonacceptance of that floor is a flat refusal.
amounts.above_full: Clarify and offer the full past-due amount; do not silently change a confirmed amount.
amounts.arithmetic: Use the API's numeric amounts. No discount, invented currency, rounding rule, waiver or payment plan is introduced. Preserve the customer's accepted numeric value.

negotiation.refusal: A flat refusal or a genuine non-answer consumes the next available persuasion opportunity. A no to today with neither date nor amount is a flat refusal.
negotiation.proposal: A supplied date or amount is handled as a proposal, including incomplete proposals; parser failure does not make it a refusal.
negotiation.attempts: Track attempts and rejected amount/date pairs per product. Never repeat a rejected offer. Stop when the product's allowance is exhausted.
negotiation.hardship: Illness, family death or job loss takes precedence over ordinary persuasion and restructuring. Give one short sympathetic sentence and offer support, without persuasion. Accept a voluntary valid proposal. Accepted support transfers; declined support resolves remaining unpromised products as hardship.
negotiation.paid: Only a payment of the current past-due amount is paid. Say payments can take one business day to appear. Continue other products.
negotiation.dispute: Denial of ownership, never having the product, or historical closure/payoff is dispute. Do not argue or take a promise for that product.
negotiation.restructuring: Transfer to restructuring without describing a plan.
negotiation.human: Ask once whether the assistant can help first. On insistence, transfer to general. Applies before and after verification.
negotiation.no_talk: A second statement that the customer does not want to talk terminates negotiation: before verification not_verified/declined; after verification remaining products refused.
negotiation.ai: Say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue.
negotiation.scam: Say the customer can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. Do not invent that number.
negotiation.unknown_information: Say 'I do not have that information.'

confirmation_and_writes.readback: Read every proposed product, amount and date together and ask exactly 'Do you confirm?'.
confirmation_and_writes.correction: Retain unchanged products and terms; resolve a correction against the actual read-back. Clarify an ambiguous product reference before changing anything. Revalidate and read everything back again.
confirmation_and_writes.authorization: All account discussion and product writes require verified identity and a successfully loaded, validated account.
confirmation_and_writes.promise_retry: One initial create_promise call and at most one explicit retry per product. Automatic write retries are zero.
confirmation_and_writes.success: Every endpoint requires HTTP 200 and body ok:true. A transport-wrapper success alone is insufficient.
confirmation_and_writes.immutable: One recorded promise per product. Do not modify, cancel or duplicate it. Refer change requests to the mobile app.
confirmation_and_writes.confirmation_sentence: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
confirmation_and_writes.notes: At final non-transfer resolution, call add_note once successfully for each product without a recorded promise, with its actual product_id and refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error. No note for a recorded product. No notes on any transfer. Notes are deferred until immediately before farewell and closure.
confirmation_and_writes.pending_on_transfer: Discard unrecorded agreements; retain recorded promises; emit no notes.

closing_combinations.when: At least one promise was actually recorded and no transfer succeeded.
No promise was recorded and every product's successful note is paid.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product in account order is refused.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product in account order is hardship.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product in account order is dispute.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product in account order failed both promise writes.
Second identity refusal/purpose question or second pre-verification no-talk statement.
No callback offered or second out-of-window callback proposal.
Number does not belong to the customer.
Still unclear after two delivered name questions.

policy.closing_protocol: Complete required writes, deliver truthful confirmations, thank the customer and say goodbye, then call close_call exactly once as the final bank operation. Omit reason for promise and paid. Hang up silently only after actual close_call success.
policy.unspecified_service_failures: The brief specifies a retry outcome only for create_promise. Other failed operations are not relabeled as successful, security failures or promise service_error. This workflow stops bank actions in an explicit technical hold after such a failure. A failed close_call cannot both satisfy exactly-one invocation and successful-closure gating; it therefore remains in that hold without a second close or a false successful hangup. This is an unresolved source-contract failure case, not an invented bank closing code.
policy.architecture: Fifteen nodes are used because security, callbacks and collection require different permitted questions, seven separate engine-run bank operations require distinct nodes, and farewell must precede the final bank operation. All extraction is consumed once using declared neutral sentinels. Additional nodes provide fail-closed evaluation and terminal success gating.
policy.validation_status: Checks below are authored local fixtures, not claims of executed code, speech extraction or live-dialogue testing. No tools were called. No usable synthetic test identity was supplied, so smoke is omitted; individual-brief mode omits scenarios.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, politely and briefly, addressing the customer by the supplied title and last name. Never reveal account information before both prescribed security checks and a successful account lookup. Never invent an amount, currency, product, date, phone number, reason or payment plan. Fixed speech supplied by the workflow is authoritative. Do not narrate tools, state, routing or internal processing. After a result, the engine immediately supplies the next permitted question or action. Only the terminal ends the call.

opening.name: opening

on_enter.text: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

opening.task_message: If the required opening has not been spoken in the actual history, first say 'I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.' Then ask 'Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?'. A greeting, go ahead or who is this is not name confirmation. Do not disclose the purpose, product, debt or payment. No tool call is allowed. The engine evaluates the fresh reply; do not improvise security questions.

extraction_schema.name: id_event
extraction_schema.description: Classify only the newest caller reply. self requires yes, that's me, speaking, or the caller's own name confirming the person just asked for. A greeting/go ahead is unknown. other includes relatives offering to pay; wrong_number and deceased are explicit reports. about asks the purpose. human requests a person. No account facts may be inferred. Use none only for no fresh reply.

transitions.description: Evaluate the fresh caller reply, including caller-first starts.

identity_question.name: identity_question
identity_question.task_message: The initialized speech is the complete authorized utterance. Wait for the caller's answer. No tool call is allowed. Permitted questions are name confirmation, date of birth, last four digits of the phone number on file, month as a word after the bank's swapped-date hint, missing components of those same answers, or whether you may help first after a human request. Ask date of birth before phone digits. Never ask another security question or reveal account information. A relative must not supply security answers. Do not interpret an earlier failed result as a new answer.

extraction_schema.name: id_event
extraction_schema.description: Newest reply only. self is explicit confirmation of the requested person. answer supplies security information; yes/no answer the current help-first question. about means asking the purpose instead of answering security. Preserve corrections in the component fields. unknown is ambiguous; none means no fresh reply.

extraction_schema.name: id_day
extraction_schema.description: Birth day explicitly supplied or corrected in this reply, normalized to digits, otherwise empty. For an all-numeric date use day/month/year. Do not supply a value from bank data.

extraction_schema.name: id_month
extraction_schema.description: Birth month explicitly supplied or corrected in this reply, 1–12 as digits, otherwise empty. Convert a spoken month name. Use the corrected portion of a sentence.

extraction_schema.name: id_year
extraction_schema.description: Birth year explicitly supplied or corrected, four digits when unambiguous, otherwise preserve the supplied digits. Never infer a century.

extraction_schema.name: id_month_word
extraction_schema.description: yes only if the caller actually said the birth month as a word in this reply; no for a numeric month; none if no month supplied.

extraction_schema.name: id_digits
extraction_schema.description: Phone-last-four digits supplied by the customer. Preserve leading zeroes and corrected values. If the new reply unambiguously completes earlier partial digits, return the assembled four digits; otherwise return this reply's fragment. Never fill from account facts.

extraction_schema.name: id_digits_mode
extraction_schema.description: append for a continuation fragment, replace for a correction replacing the previous fragment, complete for a complete or unambiguously assembled four-digit answer, none if no digits.

callback_question.name: callback_question
callback_question.task_message: Wait after the exact initialized callback question. No tool call is allowed. Ask only when the named customer can be reached or for a missing callback date/time. Do not disclose why Freya Bank is calling or discuss security, products, payments or debt with a third party. Do not collect a relative's security answers. A second complete invalid callback proposal ends callback attempts.

extraction_schema.name: cb_event
extraction_schema.description: Newest callback reply. proposal supplies a date/time or missing fragment; no_callback explicitly declines or says no reachable time is available. Unknown is not an invented callback.

extraction_schema.name: cb_date
extraction_schema.description: Verbatim callback date expression, preserving today/tomorrow/this weekday/next weekday and any correction. Do not resolve relative dates with the real clock. Empty when not supplied.

extraction_schema.name: cb_time
extraction_schema.description: The customer's unambiguous callback time normalized to HH:MM in 24-hour time. Do not guess AM/PM if ambiguous. Empty when missing or ambiguous.

transitions.description: Validate the fresh callback proposal against the call clock.

collection_question.name: collection_question
collection_question.task_message: The initialized speech is the entire authorized question or read-back. Wait for the fresh answer; no tool call is allowed. Questions may ask whether the customer accepts the stated agent-proposed amount/date, ask for an exact payment day, clarify which loaded product a statement concerns, offer support after hardship, ask once whether you may help before a human transfer, or ask 'Do you confirm?' after the collective read-back. Never ask how much they can pay. Never independently repeat or invent an offer. Preserve all products and unchanged terms during corrections. Do not continue identity questioning. Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled; changes belong in the mobile app.

extraction_schema.name: c_event
extraction_schema.description: Newest reply only. A date/amount proposal is never no/nonanswer. Historical closure or payoff is dispute, not paid. Hardship is illness, family death or job loss, even with a plan request; retain any voluntary terms in slots. nonanswer is an actual irrelevant/no-answer response to the payment offer; unknown means extraction or meaning is unresolved. yes/no apply to the actual current question. none means no fresh reply.

extraction_schema.name: c1_kind
extraction_schema.description: First correlated product statement in the newest reply. promise includes voluntary amount/date corrections; paid means this current past-due amount was paid; dispute includes historical payoff/closure. none if absent.

extraction_schema.name: c1_ref
extraction_schema.description: The first statement's spoken product reference, such as card, card ending 4821, personal loan, car loan, all, both or everything. Preserve ordinary aliases; do not invent an internal product ID. Empty if the caller did not name a product.

extraction_schema.name: c1_amount
extraction_schema.description: Only the first statement's customer-supplied amount, normalized to an ordinary decimal number without currency symbols when unambiguous. Preserve its corrected value. Empty if absent; never infer an offer amount.

extraction_schema.name: c1_date
extraction_schema.description: Only the first statement's verbatim payment date or period. Preserve next/this weekdays, month names, ordinal day fragments, and corrections. Do not resolve relative dates using the system clock or turn a vague period into an exact date. Unrelated small-talk dates are empty.

extraction_schema.name: c2_kind
extraction_schema.description: Second correlated statement, with the same definitions as c1_kind; none if absent.

extraction_schema.name: c2_ref
extraction_schema.description: Spoken product alias for the second statement, or all/both/everything. Never invent an internal ID. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: c2_amount
extraction_schema.description: Customer-supplied corrected decimal amount for the second statement only, otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: c2_date
extraction_schema.description: Verbatim payment date/period for the second statement only. Preserve relative wording; do not infer from unrelated small talk.

extraction_schema.name: c3_kind
extraction_schema.description: Third correlated statement, with the same definitions as c1_kind; none if absent.

extraction_schema.name: c3_ref
extraction_schema.description: Spoken product alias for the third statement, or all/both/everything. Never invent an internal ID. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: c3_amount
extraction_schema.description: Customer-supplied corrected decimal amount for the third statement only, otherwise empty.

extraction_schema.name: c3_date
extraction_schema.description: Verbatim payment date/period for the third statement only. Preserve relative wording; do not infer from unrelated small talk.

transitions.description: Evaluate fresh statements together without losing their product/amount/date association.

evaluate.name: evaluate

transitions.description: Any unrecognized state or code failure stays outside account dialogue and bank writes.

farewell.name: farewell
farewell.task_message: The initialized truthful confirmation and farewell are the complete utterance. Ask nothing and call no conversation tool. The engine performs the required final bank closure immediately after this speech.

transitions.description: Run the final bank operation immediately after the farewell, without waiting for another reply.
Only an actual successful bank closure permits hangup.
Do not duplicate the closing call or falsely report success.

technical_hold.name: technical_hold

on_enter.text: I could not complete that action. I do not have any further information.

technical_hold.task_message: A required operation or validated state is unavailable. No tool call is allowed. Do not disclose account facts, invent a result, repeat a bank write, perform another closing call or claim completion. If asked, say only that you could not complete the action and do not have further information. There is no source-authorized alternate successful outcome for this technical failure.

verify_identity.description: Engine-run security validation only, after a complete customer-supplied answer has been normalized. Never validate a partial answer. No automatic retry; wrong answers return to the speaking security stage. The bank's swapped-date hint is not a wrong answer.

field_descriptions.field: date_of_birth first, then phone_last4 only after the birth-date check passed.
field_descriptions.answer: Validated customer-supplied YYYY-MM-DD or exactly four digits preserving leading zeroes.

get_account.description: Engine-run lookup only after both prescribed security checks succeeded. Do not substitute test fixtures or proceed on an unsuccessful response.

field_descriptions.customer_id: The exact supplied call customer_id, after authorization.

create_promise.description: Engine-run write only for the validated product/amount/date in the collectively confirmed read-back. One product at a time. Automatic write retries must be zero; the evaluator permits exactly one explicit retry after failure. Never modify or duplicate a successful promise.

field_descriptions.product_id: Exact product_id from the successfully loaded account and confirmed read-back.
field_descriptions.amount: The customer's confirmed numeric amount, inclusively between this product's floor and past_due.
field_descriptions.date: The confirmed ISO business date, from today through this product's deadline.

schedule_callback.description: Engine-run callback only after date and time pass the source window. Never silently replace the customer's proposed callback date or time. No automatic write retry.

field_descriptions.date: Validated customer-proposed date, today or the next business day, ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
field_descriptions.time: Validated customer-proposed HH:MM, inclusive 10:00–19:00 and strictly later than the call's now.

transfer_to_agent.description: Engine-run accepted support transfer, restructuring request, or insisted-upon general human transfer. Do not record pending promises or issue any product notes on a transfer. No automatic write retry.

field_descriptions.queue: support after an accepted hardship offer; restructuring for an applicable restructuring request; general after the one help-first question and continued human request.

add_note.description: Engine-run final-resolution note for a product without a recorded promise. Never call before final resolution or on any transfer. No automatic write retry.

field_descriptions.product_id: Actual product_id from the successfully loaded account.
field_descriptions.reason: The resolved product reason: refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error. service_error means both allowed promise writes failed.
field_descriptions.text: Optional. Omit; no invented narrative or sensitive security answers.

close_call.description: Engine-run exactly once, after the spoken thanks and goodbye. This is the final bank operation. Automatic retries must be zero. Silent hangup is allowed only after HTTP 200 with ok:true.

field_descriptions.outcome: Deterministically reconciled against successful transfer, actual recorded promises, successful product notes or the specific unverified/third-party result.
field_descriptions.reason: Omit for promise and paid. Otherwise use only the reason allowed for this outcome in the source closing table.
